{"path": "todo_openrouter-moonshotai-kimi-k3_01.html", "edit_description": "Create a new single self-contained HTML file implementing a complete Todo app (no external dependencies, no CDN links — all CSS in a <style> tag in <head> and all JS in a <script> tag at the end of <body>).

Requirements:
1. Add new todos: an input field and Add button (also submit on Enter key). Ignore empty/whitespace-only input. Clear input after adding.
2. Mark todos as complete: each todo item has a checkbox; completed todos show strikethrough text (CSS text-decoration: line-through) and visually muted color.
3. Delete todos: each item has a delete button (✕) that removes the todo.
4. Filters: three buttons "All", "Active", "Completed" that filter the visible list; the active filter button is visually highlighted. Filtering must not delete data — only change what's shown.
5. Persist to localStorage: save the todos array (objects with id, text, completed) under a key like 'todos' on every change (add/toggle/delete); load and render on page load. Use JSON.stringify/JSON.parse with a try/catch fallback to an empty array.

Implementation details:
- State: let todos = [] loaded from localStorage; let currentFilter = 'all'.
- Use crypto.randomUUID() if available else Date.now()+Math.random() for ids.
- Render function re-renders the <ul> list based on currentFilter; use textContent (not innerHTML) for todo text to avoid XSS.
- Show an item count like "N items left" (count of active todos).
- Optional nice touches: empty-state message when list is empty, "Clear completed" button, editable on double-click is NOT required — keep scope to the requirements plus item count and clear-completed.
- Clean modern CSS: centered card layout (max-width ~500px), system font stack, subtle shadows, rounded corners, hover states, responsive. Light background gradient is fine.
- Semantic HTML5: header/main, form with label (visually hidden label ok), aria-labels on checkbox and delete buttons for accessibility.
- The page title should be "Todo App".
Deliver the complete file content."}
